keyFindings.question: Q3

resolvedQuestions.answer: The outside-specs census is complete across the router, AGENTS.md, the 13 bodies, the checker, the skill/command/agent surfaces and the benchmark generator.

Mirrors map to authored sources and checkers; both gate surfaces are characterized; the four retrieval artifacts are deterministic for a fixed corpus and must be regenerated together after the migration's doc edits.
Siblings link into the main checkout and survive through the farm; the dual-root probe, resolved-containment row classification and farm-check placement are specified.
